missions.title: Build a modern AI SaaS landing page for “FlowBoard” — a collaborative project ma
missions.goal: Build a modern AI SaaS landing page for “FlowBoard” — a collaborative project management platform for startups. Create a beautiful homepage with a glassmorphism design, dark theme, animated hero section, pricing cards, testimonials, FAQ, responsive navigation, authentication pages, dashboard layout, and reusable React components. Generate production-ready code using Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and shadcn/ui. Ensure accessibility, smooth animations, and clean component architecture.

missions.title: Enhance accessibility of the hero section with ARIA and reduced‑motion support
missions.goal: Enhance accessibility of the hero section with ARIA and reduced‑motion support
missions.summary:
{
  "approved": false,
  "qualityScore": 78,
  "summary": "The artifacts show an effort to add ARIA attributes and reduced‑motion support to the hero section, but several accessibility details are incomplete or missing, preventing full compliance with WCAG 2.1 AA.",
  "issues": [
    "Missing or incomplete ARIA labels/descriptions on interactive hero elements (e.g., CTA buttons, carousel controls).",
    "Reduced‑motion media query not consistently applied to all CSS animations/transitions in the hero section.",
    "No keyboard focus management for dynamic content (e.g., slide changes) – focus can be lost or trapped.",
    "Missing lang attribute on <html> and insufficient color contrast verification for hero text over background images.",
    "No fallback content or noscript handling for users with JavaScript disabled.",
    "Absence of automated accessibility testing (e.g., axe, jest-axe) in the provided files.",
    "HeroSection.jsx lacks proper semantic heading structure (e.g., missing <h1> for the primary headline)."
  ],
  "recommendations": [
    "Add explicit aria-label or aria-labelledby to all buttons, links, and carousel controls; ensure decorative images have alt=\"\" and informative images have descriptive alt text.",
    "Extend the prefers-reduced-motion media query to disable or replace all hero‑section animations, transitions, and parallax effects.",
    "Implement focus trapping or restore focus after slide changes; use tabindex=\"-1\" on off‑screen slides and manage focus with React useEffect hooks.",
    "Verify color contrast ratios (minimum 4.5:1 for normal text) and add a lang attribute to the <html> element (e.g., lang=\"en\").",
    "Provide a noscript fallback that displays static hero content without relying on JavaScript.",
    "Integrate automated accessibility tests (axe-core, jest-axe, or similar) into the build/CI pipeline to catch regressions.",
    "Ensure the hero section uses a logical heading hierarchy (<h1> for main title, <h2> for sub‑title, etc.) and consider adding a landmark role (role=\"region\" with aria-labelledby) for screen‑reader navigation."
  ]
}
